title: Why Volatility Gets 42% Worse the Longer You Hold Your Strangle
description:
How does volatility change over time when trading strangles and straddles?

In this Market Measures segment we explore how P&L volatility evolves as options approach expiration and why straddles typically experience larger swings compared to strangles.

We examine how delta, gamma, and time decay impact option positions and why traders often prefer out-of-the-money strangles to manage risk more effectively.

The discussion also highlights why many options traders choose to manage positions around 21 days to expiration rather than holding trades all the way to expiration.
